commerce.title: Commercial systems
commerce.problem: When sales and customer service use separate information, every order means piecing the context back together.
commerce.solution: I connect orders, customers and availability so sales and follow-up can work from the same system.
commerce.result: Less duplicate work and better-informed customer service.
commerce.examples: A point of sale linked to inventory; a customer ordering portal.

operations.title: Management and operations
operations.problem: Scattered spreadsheets and informal handovers make it hard to see what is pending and who needs to act.
operations.solution: I design management tools with clear states, responsibilities and traceable processes.
operations.result: A clearer view of operations and better coordination.
operations.examples: Inventory across locations; delivery planning and tracking.

applications.title: Web and mobile applications
applications.problem: Work does not always happen at a desk: customers and teams need access from different devices.
applications.solution: I build web and mobile experiences around each person’s tasks, connected to the central operation.
applications.result: Information and actions available where they are needed.
applications.examples: A field application; a customer self-service portal.

automation.title: Automation and integrations
automation.problem: Copying data between tools takes time and can leave conflicting versions of the same operation.
automation.solution: I integrate systems and automate tasks with explicit rules, traceability and error handling.
automation.result: More consistent workflows with less manual intervention.
automation.examples: Generating documents from orders; synchronizing sales and management systems.

intelligence.title: Data and artificial intelligence
intelligence.problem: Collecting data is not enough without a useful way to interpret it, make decisions or answer questions.
intelligence.solution: I organize information, build indicators and introduce AI assistance where the problem and available data support it.
intelligence.result: Evidence-based decisions and assistance with clear boundaries.
intelligence.examples: An operations dashboard; an assistant that queries business information.

process.collaboration: You provide context and validate decisions. I design, implement, test and document the solution, and support its launch within the agreed scope. Pace and next steps are defined for each project.

understand.title: Understand
understand.work: Explore the operation, the problem, constraints and objectives before proposing a solution.
understand.deliverable: A shared summary of the problem, objectives and points that need confirmation.
understand.client: Share context, processes and constraints; confirm that the problem has been understood.
understand.professional: Listen, analyze and organize findings and open questions.

define.title: Define
define.work: Agree on scope and priorities, design the experience and explain technical decisions.
define.deliverable: An agreed scope, priorities and acceptance criteria to guide implementation.
define.client: Prioritize needs and validate scope, experience and business decisions.
define.professional: Propose options, explain trade-offs and design a feasible solution.

build.title: Build and validate
build.work: Implement in increments and assess each delivery through testing and review.
build.deliverable: Reviewable increments, test evidence and a record of agreed adjustments.
build.client: Review progress and give feedback on how it fits the operation.
build.professional: Implement, test, fix issues and communicate progress and limitations.

evolve.title: Deliver and evolve
evolve.work: Prepare documentation and deployment, define useful metrics and agree on continued support.
evolve.deliverable: The agreed solution and documentation, with launch criteria and next steps.
evolve.client: Validate delivery, coordinate adoption and prioritize future improvements.
evolve.professional: Document, support deployment and propose improvements within the agreed scope.

about.approach: I bring together product thinking, architecture, development and data to turn business needs into practical solutions. Technology choices follow an understanding of the context, constraints and people who will use the product.
about.responsibility: I take responsibility for explaining decisions, maintaining quality and documenting what is needed to operate, maintain and continue the product.
about.collaboration: I work through direct collaboration and clear communication: reviewable progress, explicit limits and agreed next steps.

Privacy.introduction: This policy describes current behaviour and the approved rules for upcoming features. Optional analytics, contact delivery and demo sessions are not enabled yet.

responsible.title: Controller and purposes
responsible.body: Nahuel Martínez is responsible for this professional website. Necessary data supports content and preferences and, when enabled, responding to enquiries and running temporary demonstrations.

contact.title: Contact and messages
contact.body: The form asks for a name, email, optional company, optional project type, message and privacy acceptance. In this version validation happens in your browser: no data is sent or stored. Once enabled, the channel will save the enquiry before attempting an email notification, without an initial automatic reply.

preferences.title: Necessary preferences
preferences.body: Your language is kept in a first-party cookie for one year. An explicit theme choice is stored locally in the browser until you change it or clear site data. Future demo and administrative sessions will use strictly necessary cookies while those features are in use.

analytics.title: Optional analytics
analytics.body: First-party analytics will remain disabled until explicit consent. Once the mechanism is available, you will be able to accept, reject or change your choice; the preference will last 180 days unless the purpose changes materially. Rejection will not limit content or demos. This version does not collect or send analytics events.

demos.title: Demonstrations and disposable data
demos.body: ACME Café and ACME Logística are fictional businesses. Their demos are not available yet. Once enabled, operations will use simulated data in one-hour sessions, followed by daily cleanup. Real personal data should not be entered in the demos.

excluded.title: Data excluded from analytics
excluded.body: IP addresses, names, emails, messages, free text, signatures, photographs and internal demo content will not be stored as analytics. Planned dimensions are limited to categorical events, pages, language, theme, device, browser family, permitted referral information, aggregate duration and a pseudonymous session.

recipients.title: Recipients and services
recipients.body: There are no third-party trackers, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or equivalent services. Future analytics will be first-party. Resend is planned for production contact notifications; Mailpit will be used locally. This transport is not connected to the public form yet. Recipients and their terms must be confirmed in the legal review before production.

retention.title: Approved retention periods
retention.body: Contacts: 24 months from the last interaction. Raw analytics events: 180 days; session summaries: 24 months; anonymised daily aggregates: while useful. Demos: one hour of use followed by daily cleanup. Administrative sessions: 8 hours; administrative audit: 180 days; ordinary technical logs: 30 days. These rules will apply as features are enabled.

rights.title: Exercising your rights
rights.body: You can request access, correction or deletion of your data from the controller through the contact channel once enabled. A valid deletion request will take precedence over planned retention where applicable. The channel does not currently receive requests; an operational route must be published before production.

review.title: Review before production
review.body: This wording requires legal review before production. The channel for exercising rights, recipients and applicable terms will be confirmed while respecting the approved technical decisions.
